title: River Green Society

backend.plotsQueryNote: The old River Green map sent NO colony_name and therefore received the Phase 2 rows too (C-1 RESERVED and B-3 SOLD from Phase 2 were painted on River Green). Send colony_name and also filter rows client-side by row.colony_name === 'River Green Colony'.
backend.configQueryNote: old map sent no colony_name here (server returned the River Green key and default_booking_amount 25000 on 2026-10-12); keep identical
backend.bookByLabelEndpoint: POST /bookings/public-book-by-label (plot_label, site_id=1; River Green sends NO colony_name)

source.capturedFrom: https://defencegarden.com/project/1 (RiverGreenMap-xvA5nAeC.js), rendered in Chrome on 2026-10-12, measured on a 1:1 clone of the 1460x1370 map root; clip-path polygons applied
source.coordinateSpace: 1460x1370 CSS px of the old fixed canvas (also the SVG user space). The old page scaled it with scale = max(320, min(innerWidth,1280) - (innerWidth<768 ? 48 : 100)) / 1460.

statusModel.matchRule: normalise both sides: trim, toUpperCase, strip '(' ')'; look up exact, then without '.' and '-', then with a '-' inserted after the leading letters (C12 -> C-12)

BOOKED.label: Booked
BOOKED.note: treated like RESERVED by the Phase 2 map, like an unknown non-available status by the River Green map

OTHER.label: (raw status text)
OTHER.note: any other value: RG paints #E74C3C; DG2 paints it green (bug) but the modal still blocks booking because status !== AVAILABLE

layers.note: perimeter road drawn as a 25-unit stroke (round joins) around this polygon; the plot area sits inside it
old: 12 decorative rings (18px, 4px #2c8f30 border) rotated every 30deg at radius 22 + a 14px black fountain dot

decor.treesNote: positions of the emoji trees of the old map (20 median trees hidden under road labels / the roundabout were dropped). Draw them with an original glyph or omit.

dataQuality: Old River Green map requested site-plots/1 without colony_name; the API returned both colonies' rows, so River Green C-1 showed RESERVED and B-3 showed SOLD using Phase 2 data (2026-10-12). Fix: send colony_name and filter rows by colony_name.

Only 11 plot rows existed in the backend for site 1 on 2026-10-12 (4 River Green: A-1 RESERVED, A-2, A-3, C-19 RESERVED; 7 Phase 2). Every other plot is not in the database: it renders AVAILABLE and is booked by label (POST public-book-by-label).
Zone 'S' units are drawn pink and labelled '(S1)'…'(S34)' on the old map; their meaning (shops?) is not stated anywhere — keep the label text, do not invent a name.
Plot IDs are unique on this map. Numbering gap: there is no A-44 on the old map (A-43 is followed by A-45) — confirm with the sales team whether A-44 exists.
